mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand, proxied by HOUST, leads to higher corporate earnings expectations and thus a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Significant negative 20-day forward returns when HOUST shows persistent upward momentum but SPX underperforms sector benchmarks.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment, measured by PAYEMS, reduces labor market uncertainty and boosts investor confidence, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: No significant correlation between PAYEMS momentum and SPX 60-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in the CPIAUCSL exceeds +2%, it indicates accelerating inflation, which typically precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: No negative 20-day returns when CPIAUCSL shows >2% monthly increase, or SPX outperforms inflation by >1% in the subsequent 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests weakening demand, which reduces growth expectations and produces a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day forward returns when INDPRO shows consistent contraction over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both HOUST (consumer) and RSAFS (retail) signals dual demand channels, amplifying positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly different from a single-demand proxy (HOUST or RSAFS) in the same window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 5% triggers a risk-off cascade that drives negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: No negative 60-day returns when UNRATE crosses above 5% from below, or SPX beats the S&P 500 Global Earnings Index by >2% in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rates held steady during a regime of persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 330), creating a forward discounting effect that produces positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: No positive 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS unchanged but CPIAUCSL < 330, or discount rate implied by SPX futures does not fall.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes where GDP growth is missing (indicated by a long-term decline in INDPRO), S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days are negative due to muted earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO in downward trend for 12 months
failure_condition: Positive 60-day forward returns when INDPRO shows a sustained upward trend or GDP growth is reported above historical averages.
